code_examples.section: ltm rule command LB src tag
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

LB::src_tag
       Sets the source tag for the current request.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       Sets the source tag for the current request

       LB::src_tag 
	   Sets the source tag for the current request. The tag will be recorded as a key to the current connection (to be looked
       up by destination tag next time).

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    LB::src_tag foo_tag
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
